_about: How the services lens recognizes web applications from the URLs stored for what a subject controls. An application is recognized on a site (scheme, host and port) when a stored URL's path matches path. versions read a release from the query parameter query of the files matching their path; each names the product it is the release of and cites the application's own source showing that this file carries that product's version. components name the add-ons (plugins, themes) a path shows; their query value is set by each add-on, so it is reported as the version written in the asset URL and not used to check vulnerabilities. url_types are the asset types holding URLs and url_field the content field with the URL. Patterns are regular expressions matched without case. Nothing is written to the Asset Database. Add values here, not in Go code.
